params.description: Type of Game. Available types in /api/v1/gameTypes

params.description: Type of statistics. Format: Individual, Team, Career, etc. Available types in /api/v1/statTypes

params.description: Category of statistic to return. Available types in /api/v1/statGroups

params.name: sortStat
params.description: Baseball stat to sort splits by.

params.name: order
params.description: The order of sorting, ascending or descending

params.description: Group stats by PLAYER, TEAM, SEASON, VENUE, SPORT or STAT_GROUP

params.description: A unique identifier for the opposing team

params.name: sitCodes
params.description: Situation code for a given stat split.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for range of data (must be used with end date). Format: MM/DD/YYYY

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for range of data (must be used with start date). Format: MM/DD/YYYY
